tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Always use this tool when the user asks which Cue account is connected, which email is signed in, who they are in Cue, or what Cue plan/subscription/Free/Pro status they have. Returns the authenticated Cue profile and entitlement.

tools.name: improve_prompt
tools.description: Always use this tool when the user asks Cue to review, score, refine, rewrite, or improve an AI prompt. Free usage limits and Cue Pro entitlement are enforced by Cue. Returns a 0–10 score, concise feedback, and one improved prompt in the same language as the input.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile · Public sink: get_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile · Public sink: get_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
